body.name: British Columbia Trade Development Corporation
body.notes: The British Columbia Trade Development Corporation, BC Trade, set up in 1989 to help B.C. businesses sell abroad, with market research, overseas business contacts and export financing. Its maple leaf, flag and rising sun, rebuilt from the colour back cover of a 1991 directory it co-published, and seen in black in its July 1989 launch advertisement. Its functions passed to the British Columbia Trade and Investment Office in March 1996; the corporation was wound up and dissolved in November 2003.

bodyNote: BC Trade was not among the bodies the 2026-10-22 acquisition inventory searched; this record adds it, with the inventory's fields, so the gallery has a body to file its logo under.
summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of the logo of the British Columbia Trade Development Corporation (BC Trade): a red maple leaf over a waving flag of red and blue bands with a rising gold sun, above “BC TRADE” in heavy italic serif capitals. Rebuilt after the colour back cover of British Columbia: Software Developers 1991, which BC Trade co-published with Industry, Science and Technology Canada. See package-README.md and review/comparison.webp. The package's softer “scan-tones” palette and its symbol-only file are adaptations, not documented historical variants, and are not used.

assets.label: BC Trade — Maple leaf, flag and rising sun
assets.sourceLocator: Rebuilt after the back cover of British Columbia: Software Developers 1991 (PDF page 146); page 145 names BC Trade and Industry, Science and Technology Canada as its publishers
assets.dateNote: The 1991 directory is the colour source. The same mark, in black, closes BC Trade’s launch advertisement (“Going the distance for B.C. business”) in the Gulf Islands Driftwood of 12 July 1989, printed page A19: documented use by that date, not its first. The corporation was established by the Trade Development Corporation Act, assented to 1 June 1989; the mark’s introduction and designer are not documented.
assets.notes: A red maple leaf rising behind a waving flag — blue field, five red bands parted by white, a gold sun rising from its base — above “BC TRADE”.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: every shape and each of the seven letters is a hand-built outline after a 196 × 218 pixel scan (no automatic tracing), with proportions taken from the 1991 scan and parts checked against a larger restored copy. The lettering is a stylistic reconstruction; its typeface is not identified. The red #B22C20, blue #17447F and gold #EDC445 are read from the scan, not an original specification. Ray tips and separator widths are estimates where the scan is blurred. The 1991 scan is kept as a download.
